global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, golden broth with visible fat swirls. Toppings—nori, chashu, menma, and naruto—are artfully arranged atop the noodles in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, set against warm wooden tones under soft, natural light.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and smooth surface texture.
regions.bowl: Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate floral pattern, smooth glazed surface, and raised decorative rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles with green onions and black pepper specks.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark, crinkled, and irregularly shaped with a rough, textured surface.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a thick, pinkish-brown slice with a seared surface, speckled with black pepper and a visible fat cap.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with visible fibrous texture and small dark specks on their surface.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale yellow, textured, irregularly shaped with faint swirl and green speckle on surface.
